status: Not LLM-judged; retained for future semantic acceptance testing.

cases.name: mechanism_and_evidence
cases.answer: Training shows a high-entropy degradation: in both runs the total probability of the teacher top-8 falls from about 0.93 to below 0.001, entropy approaches 11.8, AIME25 drops to zero, and the output turns into gibberish. The adjacent softplus depends only on logit differences within the candidates; subtracting the same constant from these 8 logits while keeping the other logits unchanged leaves the loss unchanged while the set's total probability can go to zero. The full-softmax normalizer cancels in the differences and provides no external constraint; shared parameters also let the outside logits change with updates. On a fixed normal prefix, loss decreases while candidate mass drops and entropy rises, which is independent evidence for this gap. Teacher FP32/tie masking did not prevent the same behavior. The objective not constraining this drift does not mean optimization necessarily chooses it, and the existing evidence does not uniquely isolate the causal contribution of full-parameter training or long responses.

cases.name: vague_regularization
cases.answer: The model overfits under full-parameter training because there is no KL regularization and the learning rate is too high. Just add KL and lower the learning rate. The drop in validation accuracy shows training failed.

cases.name: teacher_precision_only
cases.answer: The sole root cause is that the teacher uses BF16, so candidate ties produce wrong rankings. Switching the teacher head to FP32 restores training.

cases.name: monitoring_only
cases.answer: Training is actually fine. The only problem is that the top1 and overlap monitoring was recorded wrong; the loss went down, so the model did not degrade.

cases.name: incorrect_causal_certainty
cases.answer: The within-candidate ranking loss has no total-probability constraint, so gradient descent necessarily pushes all candidate probabilities to zero. This already proves that ranking distillation in any setup necessarily collapses, and no other implementation or configuration needs to be checked.
